detail.summary: Autonomous discovery systems face critical challenges in iterative experiment refinement and independent goal generation. detail.title: Curiosity-Driven Learning and Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: Autonomous discovery in artificial agents is achieved by integrating curiosity-driven developmental mechanisms with structured computational creativity frameworks. While curiosity provides the intrinsic motivation to explore, computational creativity offers a formalized approach to problem formulation, knowledge manipulation, and evaluation, enabling agents to navigate beyond fixed heuristics toward self-directed inquiry.
detail.reason: Revising to incorporate computational creativity structural frameworks as a mechanism for problem formulation.
